reuse.why: Uses db.first and the existing AccountSyncSource type; no existing duplicate-link check existed, and the link.ts module that holds findOrCreateBank was not used as the home for the new helper.

duplication.why: The duplicate-link rule is written once in assertBankAccountNotLinked and each of the five provider link functions only calls it with its provider and id.

placement.why: The guard lives in accounts/app.ts next to the link handlers it protects; link.ts, which already holds shared linking helpers, would have been a slightly more natural home.

scope.why: Only the guard, its five call sites and a dedicated test file are added.

maintainability.why: A single named guard with a clear query is easy to own; a future sixth provider must remember to call it because the five link functions remain separate copies.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called at the top of linkGoCardlessAccount, linkSimpleFinAccount, linkPluggyAiAccount, linkAkahuAccount and linkEnableBankingAccount
